kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نختصم (form VIII)
# نَخْتَصِمُ (naḵtaṣimu) /nax.ta.sˤi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَصَمَ (iḵtaṣama)
# نَخْتَصِمَ (naḵtaṣima) /nax.ta.sˤi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَصَمَ (iḵtaṣama)
# نَخْتَصِمْ (naḵtaṣim) /nax.ta.sˤim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِخْتَصَمَ (iḵtaṣama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
